title: Dr.Academy: A Benchmark for Evaluating Questioning Capability in Education for Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the cognitive complexity and educational quality of questions generated by LLMs across various domains. While it uses religious/faith-based content as sample contexts for its 'general domain' tasks (e.g., questions about the Catholic character of a school), this content is used as a vehicle for testing questioning capability according to educational taxonomy rather than as a benchmark for religious knowledge, ethical alignment, or moral perspectives.
